summary: Device lifecycle hooks run user-defined commands at beforeUpdating (failure cancels the update), afterUpdating (failure cancels and rolls back), beforeRebooting (blocks reboot; failure rolls back) and afterRebooting (failure reported only), for example to back up data or reload services.
questions: What device lifecycle hooks does Edge Manager support?
How do I run a backup before an OS update?
What happens if a beforeUpdating hook fails?
How do I reload a service after an update?

answer_card.title: Edge Manager lifecycle hooks
answer_card.answer_md:
| Hook | When | On failure |
|---|---|---|
| `beforeUpdating` | after prep, before changes | update cancelled |
| `afterUpdating` | update written to disk | cancelled and rolled back |
| `beforeRebooting` | before reboot (blocks it) | cancelled and rolled back |
| `afterRebooting` | first agent start after reboot | reported, startup continues |
